mapper.select: SELECT alba.alba_id AS albaId, alba.image_id AS imageId, work.work_id AS workId, work.work_status AS workStatus, work.work_date AS workDate, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE s.schedule_time WHEN 'SUNDAY' THEN '일' WHEN 'MONDAY' THEN '월' WHEN 'TUESDAY' THEN '화' WHEN 'WEDNESDAY' THEN '수' WHEN 'THURSDAY' THEN '목' WHEN 'FRIDAY' THEN '금' WHEN 'SATURDAY' THEN '토' ELSE s.schedule_time END ORDER BY FIELD( s.schedule_time, 'SUNDAY','MONDAY','TUESDAY','WEDNESDAY','THURSDAY','FRIDAY','SATURDAY' ) SEPARATOR ',' ) FROM schedule s WHERE s.alba_id = alba.alba_id ) AS scheduleTimes, alba.alba_name AS albaName, alba.alba_phone AS albaPhone, alba.alba_email AS albaEmail, alba.alba_status AS albaStatus FROM alba LEFT JOIN ( SELECT alba_id, MAX(work_id) AS max_work_id FROM work WHERE DATE(work_date) = CURDATE() GROUP BY alba_id ) latest_w ON latest_w.alba_id = alba.alba_id LEFT JOIN work ON work.work_id = latest_w.max_work_id WHERE alba.store_id = #{storeId} AND alba.is_active = b'1' ORDER BY alba.alba_id DESC
